wren.name: Wren, the Orphan
wren.blurb: Fast and fragile. Fights through her wolf pack.

ability.name: Rally the Pack
ability.desc: 6s: the wolves rush the toughest enemy near you and pin it, biting 50% harder.

elias.name: Elias, the Priest
elias.blurb: Sturdy and steady. Holy light keeps him alive.

ability.name: Candle Wheel
ability.desc: 6s: plant a ring of light. You heal while you stand inside, and your Holy Orbit lights lock into the ring and burn what crosses it.
